Lindenmoor used 2,151,400 cubic metres, equal to 2,151.4 megalitres. Its daily per-resident use was:

2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 = 202.9 litres

Kelmarsh used 1,739 megalitres, giving:

1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 = 197.6 litres

Lindenmoor’s rate was higher by 5.3 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.3
